errors.text: The central ordering mediator is assigned to B2 domains, whereas the target mechanism requires enhanced L12 ordering in the FCC domains, approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.

The hypothesis omits the coupled mechanism of elevated antiphase-boundary energy and modulus, restricted cross-slip, planar slip, dislocation pile-up, and stress concentration at jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary tips.
It substitutes an unsupported coherent-to-incoherent interface transition and possible B2 coarsening for the required evolution toward jagged phase boundaries and subsequent ductile transition zones.
It does not define the requested embrittlement boundary of approximately 550–750 degrees Celsius and misses the key 600 degrees Celsius minimum and 750 degrees Celsius recovery conditions.

The cited dislocation evidence concerns SRO effects in a BCC MoNbTaW refractory alloy and does not establish the relevant ordered-domain evidence for high APBE, suppressed cross-slip, and planar slip in L12 domains.
The proposed experiment does not explicitly require localization of pile-ups and crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips while ruling out grain-boundary impurity segregation.
